title: CLAUDE.md's command list is missing the Q-110 capture tool
tier_reason: A documentation gap in the file every session reads first; the tool exists and is green, it just is not listed where the others are.
ask:
CLAUDE.md's Commands section lists every capture_* scene with the command that runs it. Two tools added on 2026-09-19 for Q-110 are missing from it because another session was holding uncommitted edits to CLAUDE.md at the time and the rule was to commit only my own files. Add a block beside the other capture entries:

# The four things a raided square could look like (Q-110): what ships today and the three
# candidates, each on a real raided square at the size the game draws it, then the labelled
# side-by-side boards. The capture needs a display; the compose step does not.
godot --path . res://tools/capture_ransack_candidates.tscn
python3 tools/compose_ransack_candidates.py

Nothing else changes. Verify CLAUDE.md still reads cleanly around the insertion.
first_action: Open CLAUDE.md's Commands section and find the capture_overnight_plates block, which is the closest match in shape (a capture that needs a display plus a compose step that does not).
source_message: Left open by the 2026-09-19 Q-110 session, which could not touch CLAUDE.md without sweeping up another session's in-flight edits.
